chapter: Danny's rise through New York bands to Cab Calloway
title: Rudy Powell as Musa Kaleem and the Muslim identification cards
summary: Danny and Milt describe the Newark teacher who persuaded musicians to take Arab names and cards claiming descent from Abraham.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Yeah, Mosque Clubs they called them.
Anyway, it was some guy in Newark who was brainwashing them. Musa(?) Kaleem, who was Rudy Powell...
They believed that if you changed your name, that you wasn't black. When they'd get through talkin' to you and they would wash your brain, you thought you was an
Arab. You was Arab! You was ...[INAUDIBLE NAME]...
They had an identification card that read... I remember Rudy Powell's card that read "I am a descendant of the Father Abraham..."
"...Ibrahim and the Mother Hagar" -- which is a Biblical thing, you know. We are descendants of that. "And the son of Ishmael." It was on the card.
